name: Information Realization Pattern
description: Represents the relationship between an information object and its physical realization (e.g., a document and its printed copy).
competency_questions: What physical entity realizes this information object? What information is realized by this entity?
scenarios: A PDF file realizes a research paper. A printed book realizes a novel.
